title: intent: implement redb transaction wrappers
description: Implement high-level ACID transaction wrappers for complex state transitions in the intent module.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL provide atomic storage operations for session transitions.

event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL commit the report and metadata in a single transaction.

unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT allow the session to remain in an inconsistent state
unwanted.because: data integrity is a non-negotiable invariant.

invariants: The database remains valid even after a crash during write

title: intent: fix circular dependencies
description: Audit src/intent/mod.rs and break any circular imports introduced during flattening.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL maintain a directed acyclic module graph.

event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL verify zero cyclic dependencies.

unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT pass CI

invariants: Module imports follow a clear hierarchy

phase_1: Refactor imports to use domain crate as intermediary

title: ui: reactive quality score memo
description: Implement a Dioxus Memo that automatically recalculates the unified quality score when answers change.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL provide real-time quality feedback in the UI.

event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL trigger the memoized quality calculation.

unwanted.condition: IF the calculation is too slow
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT freeze the UI

invariants: The score memo is the single source of truth for the UI

title: ui: enforce continue button typestate
description: Disable the 'Continue to Define' button unless the DiscoverySession can successfully transition to ValidatedSession.

event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL disable the Continue button.

unwanted.condition: IF the user attempts to bypass via JS
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT allow the backend to accept the request
unwanted.because: rigor is enforced at all layers.

invariants: Phase gating is consistent with the domain logic

phase_0: Bind button props to score memo
phase_1: Add backend validation to transition function

title: ui: scientific rigor dashboard
description: Create a developer dashboard to inspect the raw mathematical components of the quality score and EARS parsing results.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL provide deep visibility into the analysis engine.

event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL render the rigor dashboard.

unwanted.condition: IF the dashboard leaks to production
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT allow unauthorized access
unwanted.because: internal diagnostics are for developers only.

postconditions: Dashboard renders raw JSON and graph data
